text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted
by the NHMFC as dividends to the National Govermiment as provided for under

of Republic Act No. 7656 is authorized to be adjusted to five percent
(5%), or an equivalent amount of not less than Php 36.207 Mn for 2004 and Php
SECTION 2. The adjusted dividend rate provided for under Section 1 is
only applicable on 2004 and 2005 net earnings of the NHMFC.

SECTION 3. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately,
DONE in the City of Manila, this
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven,
